meta.citation: HYG Stellar Database v4.2, David Nash (astronexus), CC BY-SA 4.0
meta.frame: ICRS, solar-system barycentre; the Sun is id 0 at the origin, at rest
meta.layout: columns names the fields; each row is one star with the same fields as data/stars.json near
meta.rvFromPrimary: near stars flagged rvFromPrimary take the radial velocity of their system primary (HYG comp_primary): a bound companion shares the system velocity to within its orbital speed
meta.selection: near: 0 < dist <= 30.0 pc plus the Sun, sorted by distance; sky: mag <= 6.5 and not near (dist > 30.0 pc or unknown), sorted by id, in data/sky.json as {columns, rows} (same fields as near)
meta.units: raDeg, decDeg deg (at epoch); distPc pc; pmraMasYr (includes cos dec), pmdecMasYr mas/yr; rvKmS km/s; mag, absmag V mag; epoch decimal Julian year of the astrometry
